description: A date range for booking stays. Every night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and your stay is drawn as one pill that wraps from week to week as you drag.

name: slot-picker
title: Slot Picker
description: Book a meeting on a real day rail. Click a free gap and drag the meeting; it hops over what's already booked, grows in place when you change the length, and shows the host's local time.

description: A boarding pass that keeps itself current. When the gate or times change, only the characters that moved roll over, and the old value stays underneath, struck through.

name: split-flap-text

name: location-picker
title: Location Picker
description: Set a pickup point the way ride apps do. Drag the map under a fixed pin; it lifts off its shadow, glides onto the nearest curb, drops, and the street rolls in.

name: contact-sheet
title: Contact Sheet
description: Pick from a shoot the way photographers do. Circle a frame in china marker, click again to strike it, and look through a loupe at the detail first.

name: use-auto-resize-textarea

description: React hook that auto-resizes a textarea to fit its content between a min and max height.

name: use-click-outside
title: Use Click Outside

name: use-copy-to-clipboard
title: Use Copy To Clipboard

name: use-mobile
title: Use Mobile
description: React hook that reports whether the viewport is below the 768px mobile breakpoint.
